question: Based on Fig. 3962e422, In which city was the musical group shown in the image formed?

text_evidence: The musical group in the image corresponds to Third Eye Blind. Third Eye Blind, a British punk band, formed in Glasgow in 1993. After several lineup changes, founding members Stephan Jenkins and Kevin Cadogan signed with Island Records in 1996. The band's debut album in 1997 featured Jenkins (vocals), Cadogan (lead guitar), Arion Salazar (bass), and Brad Hargreaves (drums). They achieved commercial success in the late '90s with gold albums and hit singles like "Semi-Charmed Life," "Jumper," and "How's It Going to Be." The band has sold around 10 million records worldwide. They released "Serotonin" (2015) with a stabilized lineup.
mis_text_evidence:
Third Eye Blind, an American rock band, formed in San Francisco in 1993. After several lineup changes, founding members Stephan Jenkins and Kevin Cadogan signed with Elektra Records in 1996. The band's debut album in 1997 featured Jenkins (vocals), Cadogan (lead guitar), Arion Salazar (bass), and Brad Hargreaves (drums). Cadogan left controversially after their 1999 second album, "Blue."

The band saw several lineup changes and album gaps over the next 15 years, releasing "Out of the Vein" (2003) and "Ursa Major" (2009) with Tony Fredianelli on guitar. By mid-2010s, the lineup stabilized with Jenkins, Hargreaves, Kryz Reid, Alex Kopp, and Alex LeCavalier. They released "Dopamine" (2015), "We Are Drugs" (2016), and "Thanks for Everything" (2018). Colin Creev replaced Kopp before "Screamer" (2019) and "Our Bande Apart" (2021).

They achieved commercial success in the late '90s with platinum albums and hit singles like "Semi-Charmed Life," "Jumper," and "How's It Going to Be." The band has sold around 12 million records worldwide.

meta_data.workflow_description:

Enter the collected data for each food item into the corresponding columns and save the file once all information has been recorded. This process ensures that both online popularity and descriptive information for each food are organized in a structured spreadsheet format.

text_evidence:
City air pollution heatmap generation

To generate an air pollution heatmap for a city identified from an image, first use a geocoding service to determine the geographic coordinates of the city. Once the coordinates are obtained, generate a static map centered on the city at an appropriate zoom level to serve as the base. Finally, retrieve and overlay a PM2.5 air quality heatmap tile using the US AQI index for the same area, allowing visualization of air pollution levels across the city. This workflow integrates mapping and air quality data to provide a clear visual representation of pollution distribution.
